raceRecap.title: Las Vegas GP
raceRecap.headline: Vegas Chaos: Max Wins Wild GP, McLarens on Podium
raceRecap.summary: Max Verstappen conquered a "surreal" Las Vegas GP with over 35 lead changes. McLaren bagged a double podium as Ferrari drama and Russell's crash spiced things up.
raceRecap.body:
What a bonkers race under the lights! Max Verstappen called it "surreal" and honestly, who could argue? We saw over 35 lead changes thanks to wild slipstreaming and deployment strategies – proper yo-yo racing from start to finish. Antonelli, who qualified fastest but started P6 due to an engine penalty, was right in the mix early on. The Ferraris provided their own fireworks with Lewis Hamilton getting spun by teammate Charles Leclerc, earning both 10-second penalties and a stern summons from Fred Vasseur for Leclerc after the race. Isack Hadjar even had a dramatic wing explosion – talk about a chaotic night!

The battle up front was something else. George Russell was properly fighting Max for the lead for ages, but then disaster struck! He locked up and hit the wall trying to pass Antonelli for second, completely throwing away a potential podium and plummeting to ninth. Then Antonelli himself had a late-race 'de-rate' or power failure, dropping him to fourth and letting the McLarens through. Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri capitalized big time, grabbing second and third – a fantastic double podium for them, especially with Piastri starting way back in 17th! Max, though, had an answer for everything and held on for the win, capping off a truly unforgettable Vegas GP.
